{{Quote|Let him go!|The customs guard orders Teff'ith to release his partner|<ref name="The Old Republic: Annihilation">''[[The Old Republic: Annihilation]]''</ref>}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''individual''' served a [[Police officer/Legends|police officer]] with the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. In [[3640 BBY]] he was serving as a guard with the [[Customs Enforcement Division]] at [[Diplomatic Spaceport 27-B]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. A [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] name [[Teff'ith]] briefly took the his [[Unidentified Coruscant Security customs guard 1|partner]] hostage to ensure that [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Satele Shan]] would be informed of her presence. The individual called for backup and over twenty CSF officers responded to the scene. The hostage situation was resolved when Grand Master Shan arrived and Teff'ith surrendered.

==Behind the scenes==
The Coruscant Security officer first appeared in the novel ''[[The Old Republic: Annihilation]]'' which was written by [[Drew Karpyshyn]] and published on [[November 13]], [[2012]].
